retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-inspired layout featuring a central airbrushed portrait within a thick circular border, topped by interlocking custom display lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, saturated composition centered on a realistic airbrushed portrait framed by a blue and yellow concentric circle. The top of the frame is dominated by heavy, interlocking custom lettering with thick black outlines and white fills, while the bottom arc of the circle contains secondary sans-serif text. The entire scene is set against a flat orange background within a thin white and black border.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking display text overlapping the top of a circular frame
Central portrait anchored within a concentric circular motif
High-contrast black outlines defining all graphic and typographic elements
Symmetrical layout with a heavy top-weighted typographic header
coreInvariants: Thick black outlines on all text and circular borders
Interlocking 'O' characters in the primary display text
Vibrant orange field surrounding the central circular element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A realistic portrait is centered within a circular frame, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, interlocking custom lettering at the top acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top text, moves down to the central portrait, and follows the circular border to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant orange negative space surrounds the central circular graphic, contained by a thin outer border.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue circular border and white text fills
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow inner glow within the circle and light blue shirt tones
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with strong value contrast provided by thick black outlines.

letterConstructionRules: Thick black outer strokes with white interior fills
Extended horizontal bars and swashes that integrate with adjacent letters
Sharp, blocky serifs on vertical stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: Double 'O' characters are interlocked like rings
The 'D' and 'B' feature large, sweeping curves that frame the rest of the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact custom decorative lettering paired with a clean, legible geometric sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Appropriate for the secondary geometric sans-serif text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat orange background with a thin black and white outer border. In the center, place a realistic airbrushed portrait of a man with a beard, framed within a thick blue circular border that has a yellow inner glow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white, custom interlocking display lettering at the top, overlapping the blue circle. Add secondary white sans-serif text following the curve of the bottom half of the blue circle.

verificationChecks: Text at top must have thick black outlines and interlock.
Portrait must be contained within a circular frame.
Background must be a solid, vibrant orange.
Secondary text must follow the bottom arc of the circle.

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Original artist logos or record label marks
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Is the top text interlocking and outlined in black?
Is the portrait centered within a blue and yellow circle?
Is the background a solid orange?
Is the secondary text curved along the bottom of the circle?
Does the overall style evoke a 1970s aesthetic?
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical layout + Interlocking Header + Circular Framed Portrait + High Saturation Palette
